description: Transition your little one to a toddler bed with this West Lake conversion kit. Made specifically for the West Lake crib, this toddler bed conversion kit offers a smooth and safe transition from crib to bed. Premium solid hardwood with West Lake's signature BrownMaple finish. Easy installation with included hardware.
